comment: The MON switch has three positions, Off, Rec Only and Always (SickoSampler.cpp:499), which is a three-way control rather than the two most of this plugin's switches use. Phase Scan is a panel switch here where sickoPlayer has it only on the menu, and it comes up on. The output range is ±5V only with the LIM switch on. The waveform display is a custom widget with no ParamWidget, so the items it carries — Reset Cursors, Copy Cue to Loop, Copy Loop to Cue and the save commands — cannot be reached by clicking it for help; the save commands and Presets also appear on the module's own menu, but Reset Cursors, Copy Cue to Loop and Copy Loop to Cue appear only on the display's menu.
